reference_usage: Inspected visually; prompt-described stylistic guidance only. Generated assets are original standalone artworks.

assets.name: technical-workbench
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone location artwork for the original dystopian cyberpunk browser game SCHISM.
Primary request: a cramped technical workbench where electronics repair, mechanics, and tailoring are all visibly practiced: a stripped circuit board and soldering iron, open gear housing and hand tools, a battered manual sewing machine with patched dark fabric and thread. One coherent room, not divided panels.
Scene/backdrop: soot-stained concrete utility room, exposed pipes, shelves of salvaged components, rainy window looking into a dense elevated industrial city. No people needed.
Style/medium: gritty painterly cinematic concept art, tactile brushwork and rough painted edges, rich material detail; terminal-noir atmosphere matching a worn urban workshop, not a glossy 3D render.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2, workbench dominates foreground and center, distinct recognizable tools in naturally clustered work zones, depth to a modest rainy window.
Lighting/mood: warm amber desk lamps against cool desaturated teal rain light; practical, resourceful, austere.
Materials/textures: chipped iron, oily steel, frayed fabric, dust, soot, damp walls, scratched surfaces.
Constraints: original artwork, no UI, no typography, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no readable signs, no border.

assets.name: broken-pda
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone inventory object artwork for the original dystopian cyberpunk browser game SCHISM.
Primary request: one battered old rugged handheld PDA, isolated with a genuinely transparent background. Charcoal rectangular casing with beveled corners, small physical blank keypad beneath the screen, one burnt orange fabric wrist strap attached at the bottom. Display glass is badly shattered with radiating cracks and dark exposed pixels; charging/data port along its lower edge visibly scorched and burnt. Scraped casing with small oxidized screws, recognizable as a salvageable device.
Style/medium: gritty painterly game concept art, visible brushwork and tactile surface texture, restrained desaturated teal and amber highlights on charcoal metal and plastic.
Composition/framing: square canvas, complete single handheld centered at a slight three-quarter angle, generous transparent margin, all edges and strap fully inside canvas.
Lighting/mood: soft directional practical amber highlight and dim teal edge light, grim salvaged object.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no ground plane, no backdrop, no rectangular background, no cast shadow outside the object, no UI overlay, no text, no letters or numbers on keypad or screen, no logos, no watermarks, no border, no duplicate device.
